data.cmdline:
/bin/bash -c source /root/.shell-snapshot.sh 2>/dev/null || true && export BUN_OPTIONS="--smol${BUN_OPTIONS:+ $BUN_OPTIONS}" && shopt -u extglob 2>/dev/null || true && { \builtin unalias -- 'unsetenv'; \builtin unset -f -- 'unsetenv'; } >/dev/null 2>&1 || true && eval 'sleep 20; W=/tmp/work mkdir -p $W && cd $W && (
git init -q demo && cd demo && git config user.email a@b.c && git config user.name dev && echo hi > a.txt && git add . && git commit -qm init && git log --oneline >/dev/null && git status >/dev/null && cd ..
tar czf demo.tgz demo && tar tzf demo.tgz >/dev/null && gzip -t demo.tgz
python3 -c "import json,hashlib;print(hashlib.sha256(b'"'"'x'"'"').hexdigest())" >/dev/null
for i in 1 2 3; do ls -la /etc >/dev/null; ps aux >/dev/null; df -h >/dev/null; uptime >/dev/null; sleep 2; done
curl -s -o page.html https://example.com || true
find /usr/share/doc -maxdepth 1 -name "*py*" >/dev/null
grep -r "root" /etc/passwd >/dev/null
sha256sum demo.tgz >/dev/null; cp demo.tgz demo2.tgz; mv demo2.tgz demo3.tgz; rm demo3.tgz
ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N "" -f ./id_test >/dev/null 2>&1; rm -f id_test id_test.pub
apt-get install -y -q jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
jq --version >/dev/null 2>&1
crontab -l >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
id; whoami; hostname >/dev/null; uname -a >/dev/null
cd /home/user/TRAPD/frontend && timeout 60 npx tsc --noEmit -p . >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
cd /home/user/TRAPD-Agent && timeout 90 cargo check --manifest-path agent/Cargo.toml -q >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
) > /dev/null 2>&1; echo done' < /dev/null && pwd -P >| /tmp/devtool-3eff-cwd
